purpose: Original illustration layer (src/media/): <MockMedia kind seed theme hint ratio bare />. Fills 100% of its positioned parent with a deterministic, static inline-SVG product-UI scene; the parent keeps its measured size, radius and background (no layout change). assetRole generated.ui-illustration.

props.seed: number | string; same seed -> same scene (mulberry32 over an FNV-1a hash)
props.hint: slot copy used by pickKind when kind is omitted
props.ratio: initial aspect before the box is measured (ResizeObserver)
props.bare: product window fills the box edge-to-edge (used by /templates cards)

kindSelection.note: First matching keyword rule wins; otherwise hashSeed(hint|seed) indexes the UI-kind rotation.
